verdict.rationale: Carta's docs show it holding the issuer's capitalization table as the system of record. It exposes the cap table by share class, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, SAFEs, 409A FMVs and draft option grants. Fund operators and law firms are documented as fetching cap table data on the company's behalf, which supports the claim that investors rely on it. Evidence is mostly API read access, so the founder-side maintenance workflow is largely implied. Missing for 10: share certificate management, explicit auditor-facing access or reliance, documentation of the founder editing workflow beyond draft grants, independent hands-on corroboration.
